title: Who played at Haydell's
summary: Ferbos lists Dejan, Gano, himself and a rotation of pianists ending with John Smith; the four stayed together two or three years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Listen, who all played at Haydell's? I'm going to get that straight.

Well it was Harold Bidjohn, George Gano, a big guy, myself, and then they had a little little daddy playing piano one time, Wiggy played piano a while, and then Smitty, actor who stayed the longest, John Smith.
But no change in the other three, just change in the chord? No. Well that's fantastic. You really stuck together a long time.
How many years were you there? Two or three? One or two or three years. Well what about Pichon's band? Who did he have in his band?
